notes.title: First update.2025
notes.content:
Updated content
Simple bombing mode gameplay in small scenes
Fixed incorrect display of sky system

2025 plan
1. Restore more battlefield scenery and refine the map
2. Improve a highly free future war open world
3. Switch between fpv third, person view and rts more smoothly
4. Optimize the maritime force model
5. Each building can display the interior

8. Multi-rotor drones can customize weapons
9. If there are more good reviews, we will add units: m1a1 tanks and AH64 helicopter details

notes.content:
The interface is divided into four windows, which display the hard disk, the folders under the hard disk, the files in the folder, and the history records. You can activate any of the first three windows to use the keyboard to select the files in the current window.
This included function can quickly browse the hard drive to increase your precious time
